graphiti.reason: The current local Kuzu/API adaptation is not sufficiently reliable or efficient for formal ultra-long-lifeline evaluation. Its adapter and runtime dependency are intentionally excluded until a bounded, reproducible implementation passes full-domain acceptance.

omem.reason: The official lifecycle can retry malformed router JSON indefinitely and scales one LLM call per message. Food-v4 made only about 11.6% progress after six hours and exposed unbounded retry stalls, so the adapter is intentionally excluded until retries and runtime are bounded without changing the method.
